origin.description: Tune the fixed-pattern search used by the stri_*_fixed functions.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: Logical. TRUE uses a single-code-point case mapping.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Logical. TRUE reports overlapping matches in extract-all, locate-all, and count.

origin.details: Case-insensitive matching uses ICU u_toupper on one code point. Full case mapping, which sees the whole string and the language, belongs to collation search. Overlap applies to stri_extract_all_fixed, stri_locate_all_fixed, and stri_count_fixed.
origin.value: A named list of the settings that were supplied. An omitted argument is absent, so the searcher keeps its own default. NULL drops that name.

translation.description: Tune fixed-pattern search. The dict contains only the settings that were passed.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: Logical. True asks for a single-code-point case mapping. Omit it to leave the setting out.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Logical. True asks extract-all, locate-all, and count to report overlapping matches. Omit it to leave the setting out.

translation.details: A call with no arguments returns an empty dict. None drops a name, as NULL does. A list or tuple longer than one warns and keeps the first element. An empty list or tuple raises replacement has length zero. A unique prefix such as over selects overlap.
translation.value: A dict. Names follow case_insensitive, then overlap. True and False stand for TRUE and FALSE. None stands for NULL and is not stored.
